task: Implement notify_failure for the alerting system without using the task queue notification.

candidate_memories.content: Alerting system notify_failure pages the on-call rotation and opens an incident ticket immediately.
Alert notifications must reach the on-call engineer within the SLO response window.
Incident tickets are created atomically with the alert; a separate ticket creation step is not permitted.
When notify_failure spans alerting and task queues, confirm the latency and ticket creation model.
Task queue: notify_failure enqueues a best-effort notification job for async delivery.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: async best-effort queue delivery cannot satisfy the SLO latency requirement for alerts

candidate_memories.content: Old ops note says failure notifications should be decoupled from the alerting system via a task queue.
